## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Sector Weakness). Confirmation: very low breadth (2/11) and leadership narrowly concentrated in Energy/Materials, so broad conviction is limited; style: Value/Cyclical tilt due to Energy leadership.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +7.21% | 1M: +6.98%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +8.80%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities are mildly positive on the week (Utilities 1W: +0.96%); no clear third sector leader as most other sectors are negative.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Industrials lag: EMR (1W: -5.43% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -7.48% | 1M: -4.08%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare and Technology are weak: LLY (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -3.70%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: DOW (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.73% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.38% | 1M: +15.33%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.64% | 1M: +11.12%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 concentrated in Energy/Materials), so gains are sector-concentrated.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: EMR (1W: -5.43% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, PSA (1W: -5.54% | 1M: -3.76%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -5.69% | 1M: -17.60%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -5.83%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -6.21% | 1M: -1.19%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated across Tech and Industrials/Real Estate.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: DOW (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.73% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%) ABOVE TREND. Watch short-term RECOVERY setups: TSLA (1W: +0.01% | 1M: -4.35%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.15%) RECOVERY, PFE (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -0.47%) RECOVERY — these are tactical bounces within a weak-breadth market.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is soft on the week (Technology 1W: -0.72% | 1M: +0.08%) with major names below trend: AAPL (1W: -2.53% | 1M: -0.61%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -0.25%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.53% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND while GOOGL (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +1.77%) ABOVE TREND and AMZN (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +8.25%) ABOVE TREND — narrow participation within Tech.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are under pressure on the week (Financials 1W: -1.01% | 1M: -5.56%) with large caps lagging: JPM (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -5.18%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.90% | 1M: -1.79%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -1.58% | 1M: -2.27%) BELOW TREND, so the sector is not confirming broader risk-on.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare is weak (Healthcare 1W: -1.77% | 1M: -4.26%) with LLY (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND and JNJ (1W: -2.30% | 1M: -1.67%) BELOW TREND, offset by RECOVERY names UNH (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.15%) RECOVERY and PFE (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -0.47%) RECOVERY — mixed internals.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Energy and select Materials exposure given concentrated strength (XOM, CVX, DOW ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to large-cap Tech where AAPL, MSFT, NVDA are BELOW TREND. Monitor RECOVERY names (UNH, PFE, TSLA) for confirmation before adding exposure; remain selective due to narrow leadership.

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +7.21% | 1M: +6.98%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +8.80%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND for continuation. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -3.70%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -5.83%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND for downside risk.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth: positive; Energy 1W: +5.57% | 1M: +10.17%) for widening participation. BEARISH: Technology and Industrials (Technology 1W: -0.72%; Industrials 1W: -2.15%) — watch for further earnings/news-driven weakness.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch Energy continuation triggers (sustained new weekly highs in XOM/CVX) as confirmation of sector leadership, and a reclaim of trend by GOOGL/AMZN to broaden market participation. Key downside triggers: ADBE failing to stabilize on the weekly close and INTC breaking lower momentum would signal further tech stress; UNH/PFE weekly strength would signal potential healthcare stabilization.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
PFE (+55): PFE (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -0.47%) RECOVERY — positive mid-stage breast cancer trial and price is showing a short-term bounce (confirmation). EMR (+60): EMR (1W: -5.43% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND — buyback/guidance upbeat but price is falling, a divergence to monitor for distribution.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ADBE (-55): ADBE (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -3.70%) BELOW TREND — downgrade/CEO exit and price weakness are aligned (confirmation). AMZN (-50): AMZN (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +8.25%) ABOVE TREND — negative chatter versus rising price is a divergence to watch. BA (-45): BA (1W: -3.19% | 1M: -13.23%) BELOW TREND — operational headwinds and price decline are confirming risk; FCX (-45): FCX (1W: -6.91% | 1M: -7.56%) BELOW TREND also confirms negative sentiment.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy/Materials leadership and very low breadth. XOM (1W: +7.21% | 1M: +6.98%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +8.80%) ABOVE TREND and DOW (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow leadership and tech weakness—AAPL (1W: -2.53% | 1M: -0.61%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -0.25%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (-55 news) BELOW TREND need monitoring for broader market participation or further divergence.
